flow: AMARA -> Hermes job -> backtest across counties -> summary numbers only on branch claude/frac-results

jobs.name: frac_eval
jobs.note: weekly backtest of the 13-week water and sand forecast across counties. Reads inputs built by hand from RRC DAF318 and the FracFocus CSV (FracFocus terms are accepted by a person, never by a job). Never downloads data. Publishes summary .json/.md only, never CSVs.

failure_policy: tests fail -> stop before any backtest; a failed publish never deletes local results; results are ESTIMATE-labeled backtests, not live forecasts
